outcome: Histological changes (syncytial knots, villous agglutination, infarcts, distal villous hypoplasia, vascular mural hypertrophy)
cohort: The study included 30 placentas from term pregnant women undergoing delivery, comprising 15 healthy normally situated control placentas and 15 placenta previa cases.
finding: Placenta previa was associated with lower neonatal birth weight, increased syncytial knots, villous agglutination and infarcts, distal villous hypoplasia, vascular mural hypertrophy of stem villi, and a significant decrease in CTGF expression compared to normal placentas.
mod_finding: Placenta previa was associated with a higher incidence of cesarean section.
birth_weight: N/A (neonatal birth weight was measured as an outcome, but specific inclusion criteria for birth weight are not mentioned)
